notes: Fixes the over-dark print: settings migration now resets dangerous values (gamma<0.8 -> 1.0, ink limit <180%% -> 250, ink ratio <0.9 -> 1.0, UCR=0 -> 0.6) while keeping your own paths and profiles. The gamma log line no longer claims it lightens the print when it actually darkens it, and the settings validator warns about the three darkness traps.
